# Security and private bug reports

Do not post sensitive photo files, raw EXIF dumps, IP addresses, hostnames,
absolute paths or device information in public GitHub issues.

For a sensitive security problem, use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting
feature (Security > Advisories > Report a vulnerability) if available.
Otherwise, open an issue with only a synthetic reproduction and no private
data.

The program has no network upload or telemetry facility. Backup and undo
journal files remain locally in the application's data directory.
